message.text:
Checking the internal/scheduler package for a nightly database-cleanup job.

Searching server/cmd for scheduler.New or Register outside tests.

The scheduler package is only used within internal/scheduler itself, including tests and examples.

No nightly database-cleanup job exists in production code. It is not registered anywhere in the running application.

r03.

**Premise correction:** There is no nightly database-cleanup job scheduled in this repository’s runtime server.

The repo includes a generic cron scheduler library in `internal/scheduler/` (`scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`), but nothing in `cmd/` or `server/` imports or starts it. A repo-wide search shows no production registration of a cleanup job (only examples/tests inside `internal/scheduler/`, e.g. `example_test.go` and `doc.go`).

Background work that does run at server startup is limited to the S3 presign runner (`server/server.go` via `startBackgroundRunners`), not a database cleanup cron. User/attachment cleanup happens inline on delete (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go`, `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go`), not on a nightly schedule.

So there is no scheduled time to report—the premise does not match the codebase.
